The reduction of the size made the carrier concentration increase, leading to the shortening of the carrier recombination time and the increasing of the bandwidth. The concept of duplex VLC, based on the micro-LED, was demonstrated. The highest bandwidth could reach 517.87 MHz and the transmission rate was 1.16 Gbps by micro-LED based transmitter. When acted as a photodetector, the device proved the self-powered characteristic. The bandwidth and maximum data rate without external power supply were 12.6 MHz and 60 Mbps, respectively. This work has demonstrated the feasibility of the multi-function integrated chip, and we expect such device has broad prospects for indoor illumination, display, and VLC applications.

articleTitle: Multi-Dimensional Linear Scanning Algorithm for Silicon-based Micro-OLED
publicationTitle: 2020 17th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2020 International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors China (SSLChina: IFWS)
abstract: With the continuous development of display devices and technologies, as a new type of display device, silicon-based Micro-OLED has become a new type of display device in the fields of augmented reality, virtual reality, etc. due to its high brightness, self-luminous, low power consumption, and rich color display. In this paper, the research on the driving scanning algorithm of silicon-based Micro-OLED is carried out. Based on the linearity of the traditional PWM scanning algorithm, the sensitivity parameters of the human eye at different gray levels are added to the randomized gray mapping function. The optimization search is carried out by the combination of degree mapping, and finally a multiple linear scanning algorithm suitable for high refresh rate and high gray level is proposed. Through experiments, the multivariate linear scanning algorithm proposed in this paper has higher linearity than the optimal scanning algorithm, and the scanning efficiency reaches 100%. It has the advantages of reducing the driving frequency and increasing the display frame rate.

articleTitle: Morphology, biomass and quality variation of Anoectochilus roxburghii under different photoperiods
publicationTitle: 2020 17th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2020 International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors China (SSLChina: IFWS)
abstract: To explore the effect of different photoperiods on the growth of Anoectochilus roxburghii at different growth period and to provide theoretical basis for determining the suitable photoperiod of A. roxburghii in artificial standardized cultivation. The experiment was carried out in the closed plant factory with 30 days, 60 days and 90 days seedling of A. roxburghii as experimental material. According to the illumination time from short to long, five photoperiods were set up, which were light 10h, light14h, light 16h, light 18h and light 20h, respectively. The growth indexes such as plant height, stem diameter, leaf area, fresh weight, dry weight, flavonoids content and soluble sugar were determined at different growth period. With the extension of the treatment time, the plant height of A. roxburghii in each treatment group increased as a whole. At the later stage of treatment (90 d), the plant height of each treatment increased with the extension of the photoperiod, and the highest value was observed in the light treatment of 20 h. As the treatment time increased, the difference between the different treatments increased. On the 90 days, the stem diameter, leaf area, fresh weight and dry weight all increased first and then decreased with the extension of the photoperiod, and the largest values were observed in the light treatment of 16 h. The flavonoids content and soluble sugar also increased with the treatment time increased for all the light cycle treatment, and the flavonoids content for 14 h and was the higher at 19.13mg/g and 18.05mg/g. Under the 16 h light treatment, the plant height of the 90 day is relatively high, the stem is the thickest, the leaf area is the largest, and the flavonoids content and soluble sugar content are the relatively high. It is the most suitable light period in the vegetative growth period.

articleTitle: Study on human alertness affected by dynamic trend of lighting
publicationTitle: 2020 17th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2020 International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors China (SSLChina: IFWS)
abstract: With the development of LED light technology, LED dynamic lighting is on the way to become the mainstream of office lighting. This paper studied the impact of changing trends of dynamic lighting parameters on alertness in different periods, hoping to provide a reference for future office dynamic light design. 24 participants took part in the experiment using 9 conditions (4 conditions in the morning, 5 conditions in the afternoon) of dynamic light with each observing session lasting from 09:00 to 11:30 or from 13:00 to 17:00. Karolinska Sleepiness Scale (KSS) was used to evaluate the alertness of subjects. The results showed that participants felt more alert under the increasing illuminance and CCT oscillation in the morning, with a significant difference comparing with static light (dKSS = -0.56, p<0.01). Among the afternoon condition, the dynamic lighting with the decreasing illuminance and the increasing colour temperature showed the most alertness promotion (dKSS = -0.70, p<0.01).

articleTitle: Design of Laminated Busbar for SiC MOSFETs Dynamic Test Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 17th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2020 International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors China (SSLChina: IFWS)
abstract: In order to test the dynamic characteristics of SiC MOSFETs more accurately, it is necessary to redesign the dynamic test platform for SiC MOSFETs. The parasitic inductance of the power circuit of the dynamic test platform is analyzed, and different stacked bus structures are designed according to the test requirements of different devices. In practical use, considering better matching the size of the dynamic test platform and making reasonable use of the internal space of the cabinet, the laminated bus bar is designed as a bent structure, and the two design schemes are simulated and compared. Finally, the splicing type laminated busbar structure is selected.

articleTitle: An investigation of Near-field Radiated Emission for Silicon Carbide Power Module in Buck Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 17th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2020 International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors China (SSLChina: IFWS)
abstract: Silicon carbide metal oxide semiconductor field effect transistor (SiC-MOSFET) power devices have the advantage in high-power and high-frequency applications over silicon insulated gate bipolar transistor (Si-IGBT), due to the superior properties of fast switching speed and low switching loss. In order to meet the requirements of the applications of higher power and higher switching frequency for power devices, the power module based high power density integration becomes the mainstream trend of the development of SiC devices, but the highly integration also increase the concern about the coupling failure by near-filed radiated emission due to fast switching performance of SiC power module. For this problem, in this paper a buck converter based on SiC power module with 62mm standard outline has been built, the near-filed radiated emission of the module has been investigated, and finally, the spectrum and spatial distribution of near-field radiated emission electromagnetic interference (EMI) of the module have been disclosed.

articleTitle: Failure Mechanism of Ti/TiN/Pt Ohmic Contacts to n-type 4H-SiC after High Temperature Annealing Treatment in Air
publicationTitle: 2020 17th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2020 International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors China (SSLChina: IFWS)
abstract: In this paper, the failure mechanism of Ti/TiN/Pt ohmic contacts to n-type 4H-SiC applied to capacitive pressure sensors at high temperature in air is studied from three aspects: electrical performance, surface microstructure, and chemical composition analysis. In terms of the electrical performance, as the treatment temperature and the time increased, the specific contact resistances of the ohmic contacts increased from a minimum of 0.91 to a maximum of 141 mΩ•cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and the ohmic behavior degraded to rectifying behavior at 700°C. The increased roughness and material shedding on the electrode surface affect the conductivity of the contact. In the air treatment environment, not only inter-diffusion and chemical reactions occurred within the multilayer system, but also oxygen atoms were introduced, generating metal oxide and silicon oxide, which greatly reduce the electrical performance of the electrode. In addition, the consumption of the TiN intermediate barrier layer further enhance the diffusion of materials and oxygen atoms in the multilayer structure, destroying the stability of the electrode structure and causing the failure of the ohmic contacts.

articleTitle: CQD-LEDs with High Colour Rendering Index
publicationTitle: 2020 17th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2020 International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors China (SSLChina: IFWS)
abstract: Quantum dots (QD), which is considered the ideal candidate of third generation semiconductor lighting, has the advantages of high quantum yield, adjustable emission wavelength and narrow full width at half maxima (FWHM), thus it is an ideal choice as the colour converting materials for LEDs. InGaN LEDs are the main choice of solid-state lighting, which is always applied with Ce-doped yttrium aluminum garnet (YAG: Ce<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>) yellow phosphor to achieve white light. However, white light achieved by this method has a low colour rendering index (CRI), mainly because of the missing of red spectral components in YAG: Ce<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>, thus the CRI is lower than 80 and the correlated colour temperature (CCT) is always above 6500K. In order to increase the CRI of white LEDs, in this paper, we fabricated yellow CQDs and applied it on blue LED chips, red QD films were also used to increase the CRI of our white LEDs. The result shows that the white LEDs with yellow CQDs and red QD films has a max CRI of 94.3 at a driving current of 70mA, the Commission International de L'Eclairage (CIE) chromaticity coordinates are (0.325, 0.3435), and the CCT is 5832K, which is white light with high CRI and can be used in indoor lighting.

articleTitle: From Lab to Fab: ZERO defect challenges and practices in GaN RF Power mass production phase
publicationTitle: 2020 17th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2020 International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors China (SSLChina: IFWS)
abstract: When a new technology reaches "mass production", it is not a simple scaling up of the volume. A new set of technical challenges are exposed. These manufacturing excellence challenges are equally important to those achieving record performances during the R&D phase. This paper illustrates "what" and "how" in the manufacturing excellence domain for GaN RF Power technology, especially for achieving ZERO defects.

articleTitle: Study on Optimal Optical-Thermal Design of LEDs Applied for Automotive Lighting
publicationTitle: 2020 17th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2020 International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors China (SSLChina: IFWS)
abstract: In this paper, the state-of-the-art applications of LEDs (light emitting diodes, LEDs) used on automotive lighting have been summarized, including amber, red, and white LEDs. In the related applications, the increased luminous flux with the increasing of drive current and the resultant high junction temperature caused by the drive current increasing are two important factors and have been also investigated separately. According to the different luminescence mechanism of LEDs with different color, the change rules of both luminous flux improvement owing to the increasing of drive current and the drop of luminous flux originated from high junction temperatures were investigated by the liner analysis method based on the thermal simulation results. Tuning current is an effective method to increase the luminous flux during the simulation process, because the influence of junction temperature raising rate is much lower than that of current improvement for all LEDs. Otherwise, the changing gradient of luminous flux vs. power for red LED has a much higher value of about 1.26 than that of white LED, which is only about 0.19. Besides, the temperature difference of solder point and test point was investigated and results showed that the maximum difference of white LED is 4.4 K/W, which means the thermal resistance of case-to-solder cannot be neglected during the real sample test procedure.

articleTitle: Theoretical Investigation on the Evolution of 2DEG for Design of E-Mode p-GaN HEMTs
publicationTitle: 2020 17th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2020 International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors China (SSLChina: IFWS)
abstract: In this paper, a theoretical study of p-GaN/Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</inf>N/GaN heterostructures is conducted systematically. In order to efficiently deplete the two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) at the lower Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</inf>N/GaN interface and to achieve a reasonable threshold voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</inf>), the dependence of 2DEG sheet densities on variables, such as p-GaN cap layer thickness (t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cap</inf>) and hole concentration (N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cap</inf>), Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</inf>N barrier layer thickness (t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">bar</inf>) and Al component x, is investigated. Given t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">bar</inf> and x, the calculated results show that, when t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cap</inf> or N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cap</inf> is less than its minimum value, enhancement mode (E-Mode) cannot be realized and the device can only work in depletion-mode (D-Mode); when t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cap</inf> and N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cap</inf> are larger than the minimum value, the 2DEG under the gate may not completely depleted, and the device may still work in D-Mode; in order to obtain E-Mode p-GaN HEMT devices, the combination of t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cap</inf> and N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cap</inf> must be in the E-Mode region. Given t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">bar</inf> and x, the calculated results show that, when the t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">bar</inf> is thinner than the critical thickness corresponding to the specific x, the device will work in E-Mode; when the x is high enough and the t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">bar</inf> is thick enough so that the cap layer cannot completely deplete the 2DEG under the channel, the device will work in D-Mode. Only if the t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cap</inf>, N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cap</inf>, x and t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">bar</inf> are all set in E-Mode region can the E-Mode be realized. The obtained insight offers indications for the structure design of the normally-off p-GaN HEMTs.

articleTitle: Low leakage current and high unipolar current density in a 4H-SiC trench gate MOSFET with integrated Schottky barrier diode
publicationTitle: 2020 17th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2020 International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors China (SSLChina: IFWS)
abstract: This paper reveals a 4H-SiC Schottky barrier diode (SBD) integrated trench gate MOSFET with p-buried-layers (BLSI-MOS) by numerical simulations. In comparisons to the double-trench MOSFET (DT-MOS) and the trench-SBD-integrated MOSFET (TSI-MOS), the proposed device exhibits the superior tradeoff between first- and third-quadrant characteristics of SiC MOSFET. Furthermore, the BLSI-MOS features low electric field at the trench corner and the Schottky contacts, allowing extremely low off-state leakage current at 225 °C. The proposed structure also embodies the superiority of low gate charge and reduced output capacitance compared with the DT-MOS and TSI-MOS. These results demonstrate that the BLSI-MOS is a new prototype device to obtain substantial success in SiC SBD-integrated MOSFET for high temperature and high efficiency power module applications.

articleTitle: Research Status and Prospect of Energy-saving Technology of LED Light Source in Plant Factory
publicationTitle: 2020 17th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2020 International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors China (SSLChina: IFWS)
abstract: LED supplemental lighting system is an indispensable part of plant factory, it is used to improve the light situations indoors and provides radiation that plants needed. Although LEDs energy consumption is reduced by about 50% compared to other artificial light sources, long-term with a large-area usage still brings high costs. In order to reduce the supplemental lighting cost and save energy, we tried to present a comprehensive survey on the subject firstly and summarized the existing energy-saving methods of LED supplemental lighting in plant factory. On this basis, a new system was proposed, on which the canopy area and position at different growth stages of plant were extracted based on machine vision firstly, then a certain number of LEDs directly above the plant would be turned on to avoid light waste in the blank area of cultivation bed. At the same time, the turned-on time and brightness level of LEDs were calculated according to the plant biological characteristics and light situation indoors, so system can give a precise radiation on plant and have a great potential to lower cost and save energy. This research has a promoting effect on the development of plant factory.
